verses.text: <pb/><t>Ku zo mu yabi Ubangiji,</t> <t>Dukanku bayinsa,</t> <t>Dukanku waɗanda kuke yi masa hidima,</t> <t>A cikin Haikalinsa da dare.</t>
<t>Ku ɗaga hannuwanku sama, ku yi addu'a a Haikali,</t> <t>Ku yabi Ubangiji! <pb/></t>
<t>Ubangiji wanda ya yi sama da duniya,</t> <t>Ya sa muku albarka daga Sihiyona.</t>
